description: This PHP file defines the Proxy class within the OpenCart system, providing a dynamic proxy mechanism for models with magic methods for property access and method calls.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A class providing dynamic property access and method forwarding, used to proxy model objects within OpenCart.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve a property value from internal data array.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a property value in the internal data array.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a property is set in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Magic method to unset a property from the internal data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to forward method calls to internal data object if exists, with error handling.
